comparison_caveat: v0.3 predicts chains; v0.4 uses GIVEN target chains and different formula/retrieval inputs. Full-molecule metrics are conditional and not a causal encoder-only ablation. Same512 target IDs, oracle retrieval; not MS/MS accuracy.

decision.summary: v0.4 Polar-only改造、全库化学/检索审计、真实CPU测试、32头基GPU过拟合与checkpoint续训均已完成。FP/GINE均从新随机初始化完成20k池的500/1000/2000/3000步实测。本轮有界实验在3000步结束：最终greedy头基和完整图exact均为0，Top5仅3/512与1/512，原始公式匹配19/512与5/512。暂缓完整201.5万库预训练；5000步与50k池未执行，不据此断言它们无效。
stop_at3000_reasons: Both latest raw Polar exact and full-graph exact remain0/512; FP earlier2000 had1 raw hit that did not persist at3000.
Validity is not monotonic: FP48.44% at2000 ->42.38% at3000; GINE38.67% ->37.11%, despite lower teacher-forced CE.
Formula-consistent wrong structures dominate the successful-formula subset:19 FP and5 GINE; very few raw beam5 target-head hits.

This completes the requested initial1000 and a staged3000 bounded extension; further step/pool changes should be evaluated as separate bounded experiments rather than automatically starting full training.
next_bounded_recommendations: Use FP as a lower-cost iteration baseline while retaining GINE controls; sparse hits and one seed do not establish encoder superiority.
Compare a head/length-balanced50000-target pool and formula-aware/grammar-constrained generation, preserving the same validation cohorts and reporting raw as well as filtered metrics.
Investigate wrong-isomer errors and long-SMILES failures; template edit/copy representations are a separate ablation, not claimed implemented here.
For real MS/MS inference, provide spectral reference retrieval and independent externally supplied chain hypotheses; do not use target Polar as a query-time oracle.
comparison_caveats: v0.4 uses GIVEN chains; v0.3 predicts chains. Different formula/retrieval inputs prevent a causal encoder-only comparison.
Fixed512 validation heads are repeatedly monitored diagnostics, not an independent held-out test estimate.
Matched validation targets are known frozen-library compounds unseen in TRAIN; hits do not prove new-compound discovery.
engineering_failures_resolved_before_tra: CPU HC preparation initially performed frequent exhaustive fallback for a dominant lyso chain; replaced by an eligible TRAIN-bank index and retained the initial CPU log.
decision.windows_monitor_update: Added persistent experiment-start fault checks and preserved the original external stop reason; syntax and whole-run event inspection passed. No deliberate GPU-fault injection was attempted.

reasons: Both1000-stage teacher-forced CE decreased from about0.95 to0.80/0.81; Polar validity improved, but exact and formula matches remain0.
1000 steps*batch16 consume16000 targets, less than one traversal of the fixed20000 pool; current result is too early for a full-training recommendation.
No new GPU dumps, display resets or watchdog stops; keep Math/FP32 and the5000 total-step hard cap.
